name: dwarfstar-omp-permission-v3
purpose: Scope DwarfStar's tool-approval presets inside the Oh My Pi ACP agent: Workspace Auto never auto-allows or caches bash approvals (p0-p2); Full Auto answers ACP permission requests through acp/permission-policy.ts, located by DWARFSTAR_PERMISSION_MODULE, which only bin/dwarfstar-acp sets (p3). Without DwarfStar's environment variables the agent behaves exactly as upstream.
